name: Porter Steel & Welding Co
old_description: Since 1945, Porter Steel and Welding has provided residential and commercial fabricating on projects of all sizes.
about:
Porter Steel & Welding Co. has operated from Muskegon, Michigan since 1945. Founded as a residential and commercial fabricator, the company has served the West Michigan region for nearly eight decades, building a reputation for handling projects of all sizes. As Muskegon's long-standing residential and commercial fabricator, the business has remained a local fixture for generations.

The shop specializes in structural steel fabrication, producing beams, railings, and stairs for both new construction and renovation projects. In addition to shop fabrication, the company offers walk-in welding repairs for single parts and provides on-site installation services across a wide area that extends from Traverse City to South Haven and east to the greater Grand Rapids region. The facility operates Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., accommodating walk-in customers during business hours.

Its customer base includes residential homeowners, commercial contractors, and builders who require custom structural and architectural metalwork. The company works on projects ranging from a single weld repair to large-scale new construction, delivering quotes and fabrication with quick turnaround. The firm serves both private individuals and commercial clients, providing fabrication and installation for structural and ornamental metalwork.

Porter Steel & Welding differentiates itself through personalized service, walk-in availability for immediate small-project service, and a commitment to quick turnaround on both quotes and finished work. The company’s approach centers on attention to each project, whether a minor repair or a major build.
